findings.title: Changing RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE breaks documented/scripted exit codes
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was changed from 4 to 3, and FEATURE_DISABLED now uses 4. This changes the exit code contract documented in update-compatibility.adoc and relied on by external scripts/CI pipelines. Since this is a preview feature it may be acceptable, but it's a breaking behavior change not called out in the PR description, and any existing automation written against the old codes (recreate=4) will silently misinterpret results after upgrade.

findings.title: Exit code table doesn't match actual constant ordering
findings.body: The table lists exit code 3 for 'Rolling Upgrade is not possible' (recreate) and 4 for feature disabled, which matches the new code, but no mention is made of the previous value 4 for recreate in old docs/version compatibility notes, risking confusion for users following older guides or automation across releases during the preview window.
